target: forge.sh pr-state (gitlab) — an instance under a sub-path: base is FORGE_URL and the project path is the remainder
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/gl/g/p.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001 FORGE_URL=https://gitlab.example.test/gl
fx_http "GET /gl/api/v4/projects/g%2Fp/merge_requests/4" 200 '{"state":"opened"}'
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/gl/g/p/-/merge_requests/4; fx_show r
fx_reqs
fx_done
